editorial:
Imagine being the most popular kid in school, only to wake up one morning covered in scars and tattoos after a witch curses you. That is the wild setup of this modern fairy tale. You follow Kyle, a vain New York teen who gets transformed into a hideous monster and has just one year to find someone who truly loves him. Along the way, he meets Lindy, a kind girl who sees past his looks. The vibe is teen romance mixed with fantasy, with a glossy, music-video feel that keeps things light and easy to watch.

The acting is decent for a teen drama, with Alex Pettyfer and Vanessa Hudgens carrying the love story well enough. The pacing moves quickly, though some scenes feel rushed. The pros are the fun concept and sweet message about inner beauty; the cons are cheesy dialogue and a predictable plot. If you enjoy lighthearted teen romances, this is for you. Stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent it on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray for your collection.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, Kyle's year is almost up and he believes Lindy will never love him. He lets her go, thinking it is the right thing. But Lindy returns and tells him she loves him for who he is, not his looks. The curse breaks, his scars fade, and he becomes handsome again. The twist is that true love was never about appearance, and Kyle finally learns to value kindness over vanity. He and Lindy end up together, happy and changed.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves teen romance and modern fairy tales.
